_why: registry/telemetry.json: one row per upstream tool that can phone home (KIT_PLAN 6). A row is verified only with the file+line proving the opt-out switch, or a recorded run of the tool's own offline status command by the operator. Checked by upstream_checks.py telemetry (verified:false = WORKLIST; verified:true without evidence = VIOLATION). Workflows that start a tool (service-up, wiki-gen, optimize-loop) refuse a tool whose row is unverified.
